q: WhatsApp 设计题的核心功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 音视频通话
创建最多 100 人的群聊
发送 / 接收消息
离线期间的消息在重新上线后仍能收到（30 天内）
options_en: Audio and video calling
Creating group chats with up to one hundred participants
Sending and receiving messages
Receiving messages sent while offline (within thirty days)
why: 核心功能是群聊（上限 100 人）、收发消息、离线补收（30 天）以及消息里带媒体；音视频通话、商家交互、注册资料管理都明确划到范围之外。
why_en: The core requirements are group chats capped at one hundred people, sending and receiving messages, offline delivery within thirty days, and media, while calling is explicitly out of scope.

scenario: 群聊功能要求最多支持 100 人同时在一个会话里；这个上限后续会反复出现在建群事务、CDN 收益评估和 Pub/Sub 发布次数的计算中。
q: 群上限定为 100 人，这个量级最直接支持下面哪个实现判断？
options: 100 人已经足够多，必须像 Kafka 一样为每个群单独建一条消息队列
上限只是产品文案，对存储和路由设计没有实际约束
创建群聊时可以把所有参与者记录放进单个 DynamoDB 事务（事务上限恰好 100 items），只有逼近上限的大群才需要分批写
既然上限是 100，Pub/Sub 就必须一律按 chat 而不是 user 分区
options_en: One hundred is large enough that each group needs its own Kafka topic, like a message queue
The cap is only marketing copy with no real constraint on storage or routing
Creating a chat can fit all participant records into a single DynamoDB transaction (the transaction limit is exactly 100 items); only chats near the cap need batched writes
Because the cap is 100, Pub/Sub channels must always be partitioned by chat instead of by user
why: 群上限 100 人和 DynamoDB 单事务 100 items 的上限贴边，所以建群写入默认能塞进一次事务，只有大群逼近上限时才要分批；这个数字后面还会影响 CDN 收益评估和分区发布次数。
why_en: The hundred-person group cap lines up with DynamoDB's hundred-item transaction limit, so creating a chat normally fits one transaction and only needs batching near the cap.

scenario: 非功能需求要求「消息在中心服务器保存不超过必要时长」，服务端对离线用户未投递消息的保留期限设为 30 天。
q: 30 天这个留存期限，最直接支持下面哪种实现方式？
options: 在应用代码里永久保存每条消息，仅在读取时按 30 天过滤展示
30 天只是产品说法，数据库层不需要任何过期机制
把所有消息定期打包转移到冷备份，永不删除
给 Inbox、Message 以及附件对应的存储条目统一设置 30 天 TTL，交由存储层自动过期删除
options_en: Keep every message forever in application code and only filter by thirty days on read
Thirty days is only marketing language; the database layer needs no expiration mechanism
Periodically bundle all messages off to cold backup and never delete them
Set a thirty-day TTL uniformly on the Inbox, Message, and attachment storage rows and let the store expire them automatically
why: TTL 是零运维成本满足「不超必要时长」的实现方式：到期由存储层自动删除，不需要应用代码扫表过滤或人工归档。
why_en: A thirty-day retention window is best implemented as a TTL on the storage rows so the database expires old data automatically, instead of filtering old rows in application code.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给存储条目设置的存活期限，到期后由存储层自动删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A TTL is an expiration time after which the storage layer automatically deletes the item.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为每个接收者保存未投递消息的持久化队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inbox is a durable per-recipient queue of messages that have not yet been delivered.

q: 哪些功能被明确划为 out of scope？（多选）
options: 音视频通话
与商家 / 企业的交互
消息中的媒体收发
注册与个人资料管理
options_en: Audio and video calling
Interactions with businesses
Sending and receiving media in messages
Registration and profile management
why: 通话、商家交互、注册与资料管理都在范围之外；媒体收发是核心需求之一。列 out-of-scope 是加分项，但别为它烧掉太多时间。
why_en: Calling, business interactions, and registration are out of scope, while sending media in messages is a core requirement.

scenario: 非功能需求把「消息投递给在线用户」的延迟目标定在 500ms 以内。
q: 500ms 这个延迟目标，最直接把系统接口设计推向哪个方向？
options: 客户端每 500ms 发一次 HTTP 轮询，查询是否有新消息
维持一条长连接（WebSocket），服务器直接把消息推给在线客户端
把消息统一批量打包，每隔几秒发送一次以节省带宽
延迟目标只影响 UI 动画速度，与传输方式无关
options_en: Have the client send an HTTP poll every 500ms to check for new messages
Keep a persistent connection (WebSocket) so the server can push messages straight to online clients
Batch messages together and send them out every few seconds to save bandwidth
The latency target only affects UI animation speed and has nothing to do with the transport
why: 500ms 排除了轮询间隔带来的延迟下限，只有服务器主动推送的长连接才能稳定达标。
why_en: A five-hundred-millisecond delivery target rules out polling-style delays and pushes the design toward a persistent connection that the server can push through immediately.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于 TCP 的全双工长连接协议，一次握手后客户端与服务器可以随时双向收发消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A WebSocket is a persistent, full-duplex connection over TCP that lets client and server send messages to each other at any time after one handshake.

q: 除了低延迟，本题的核心非功能需求还有哪些？（多选）
options: 详尽的安全与反爬虫防护
保证消息必达（deliverability）
支撑数十亿用户的高吞吐
消息在中心服务器保存不超过必要时长，且系统能抵御单组件故障
options_en: Exhaustive security and anti-scraping protections
Guaranteed deliverability of messages
High throughput to support billions of users
Messages stored no longer than necessary, with resilience to component failures
why: 核心 NFR：必达、数十亿用户高吞吐、消息不超期存储、组件级容错；安全细节与反爬虫被明确放到 below the line。
why_en: The core non-functional requirements are guaranteed deliverability, billions of users at high throughput, minimal server-side retention, and resilience to component failures, while deep security work is out of scope.

q: 规划阶段关于 1:1 聊天与群聊的关键洞察是什么？
options: 1:1 只是群聊的特例（2 人群），所以按通用的群聊建模，同时聚焦 1:1 场景
1:1 和群聊差异太大，必须两套独立系统
先只实现 1:1，群聊等以后重构
群聊可以用多次 1:1 发送来模拟
options_en: One-on-one chat is just a two-person special case of a group chat, so model the general group case while focusing on the one-on-one traffic
One-on-one and group chat differ too much and need two separate systems
Build only one-on-one chat first and refactor in group chat later
Simulate a group chat by sending the same message one-on-one to each member
why: 把 1:1 看成 2 人的群聊，就能用一套通用模型覆盖两种场景；另一个规划洞察是把问题拆成「持久必达」和「实时投递」两部分。
why_en: One-on-one chats are just group chats with two participants, so the design solves the general group case while focusing on the dominant one-on-one traffic.

q: 补全 WhatsApp 设计的四个核心实体：
text: 核心实体：{{User}}（用户）、{{Chat}}（2-100 人的会话）、{{Message}}（消息）、{{Client}}（同一用户可能有多台设备）。
why: 实体是推理问题的语言基础；把 Client 与 User 分开，正是后面多设备深挖的伏笔。实体列错等于在坏地基上盖楼。
why_en: The four core entities are users, chats of two to one hundred people, messages, and clients, since one user may own several devices.

q: 为什么实体里除了 User 还要单独定义 Client？
options: 为了给每台设备单独计费
Client 只是 User 的别名，没有实际区别
为了做灰度实验分流
一个用户可能同时有手机、平板、电脑等多台设备，投递与同步要精确到设备
options_en: To bill each device separately
Client is just an alias for User with no real difference
To route users into A/B experiments
A user may own several devices at once (phone, tablet, laptop), so delivery and sync must be tracked per device
why: 用户 ≠ 设备：一个账号可能有多个客户端，各自的送达状态不同。这个区分让后面「Inbox 按 client 而非 user」的改造顺理成章。
why_en: A user can own several devices at once, so delivery and sync must be tracked per client rather than per user.

scenario: 聊天应用里客户端要高频地发送消息，同时服务器要把别人发来的消息实时推给它——收发双向且频繁。
q: 系统接口最合适的形态是？
options: REST + 客户端定时轮询
GraphQL 查询
双向 WebSocket 长连接（TLS 之上），命令即 API
每条消息发起一个新的 HTTP 请求
options_en: REST with client-side polling on a timer
GraphQL queries
A bidirectional WebSocket connection over TLS, with commands acting as the API
A fresh HTTP request for every single message
why: 高频双向更新是双向 socket 的标准适用场景：客户端开 app 即建立连接，之后收发都以命令形式走这条连接。这是实时更新模式的典型应用。
why_en: High-frequency bidirectional updates are the perfect case for a persistent WebSocket connection that carries commands in both directions.
whenOtherWins: 普通「请求-响应」型产品用 REST 更合适；本设计里附件上传也刻意绕开 socket，走独立的 HTTP 服务。
tradeoff: 长连接双向实时推送 vs 简单请求-响应模型

q: 补全客户端发往服务器的四个核心命令：
text: 客户端→服务器命令：{{createChat}} 建会话、{{sendMessage}} 发消息、{{createAttachment}} 建附件、{{modifyChatParticipants}} 增删成员；服务器→客户端则有 chatUpdate 和 newMessage 等对应命令。
why: API 以 socket 上的命令形式定义，每个客户端命令都有推送给其他客户端的镜像命令。面试时可以只写命令名，细节「稍后回来补」完全可接受。
why_en: The client sends createChat, sendMessage, createAttachment, and modifyChatParticipants commands, and the server pushes mirrored commands like newMessage to other clients.

q: 客户端收到 newMessage 后必须回 ack，这一步换来了什么？
options: 服务器能确认消息真正送达客户端本体，才敢从 Inbox 删除、不再重发——这是不丢消息的关键
客户端渲染速度更快
减少 WebSocket 握手次数
允许消息乱序到达
options_en: It lets the server confirm the message truly reached the client device before it stops resending it — the key to guaranteed delivery
The client renders messages faster
It reduces the number of WebSocket handshakes
It allows messages to arrive out of order
why: 回执机制不起眼但至关重要：强制客户端 ack，服务器才有「消息已全程送达」的确定性，必达保证就建立在它之上。
why_en: Forcing clients to acknowledge receipt lets the server know a message truly reached the device, which is the foundation of guaranteed delivery.

scenario: Chat Server 走 WebSocket 长连接，不需要按路径或 Header 把流量路由到不同服务。
q: 负载均衡器应该怎么选？
options: 必须 L7，因为它更「高级」
L4 就够：不需要任何 L7 能力时，L4 通常性能更高
DNS 轮询即可，不需要 LB
客户端自己挑服务器
options_en: It must be L7 because L7 is "more advanced"
L4 is enough: when no L7 capability is needed, L4 is usually higher performance
Plain DNS round robin, no load balancer needed
Let the client pick a server itself

why_en: An L4 load balancer is sufficient and generally faster here because none of the L7 capabilities like path-based routing are actually needed.
whenOtherWins: 需要按路径 / Header 把流量分发到不同服务、或想把同一客户端连接后的多个 HTTP 请求摊到多台服务器时，L7 才有价值。
tradeoff: L4 更高性能的直连转发 vs L7 按路径/Header 路由的灵活性

先在 Message 表写一条占位消息，之后再回填成员

Write only ChatParticipant records, leaving the chat itself with no metadata
Write a placeholder row in the Message table first and backfill members later

options: 复合主键：chatId 作 partition key、participantId 作 sort key，对 chatId 做一次 Query 即得全部成员
全表 Scan 后过滤
按 participantId 分区再二次过滤
把成员列表冗余成 Chat 表里的一个大字段

q: 文中的存储设计是？

options_en: Rely entirely on client-side local storage syncing with each other

tradeoff: 持久化优先于实时投递 vs 尽力而为的推送速度

q: 为什么这里给 blob 存储前面加 CDN 的收益有限？
options: CDN 无法传输图片视频
每个附件最多被 100 个参与者下载（群上限），缓存复用率太低，边缘缓存意义不大
CDN 与 TTL 冲突
预签名 URL 不能配 CDN
options_en: A CDN cannot transfer images or video
Each attachment is downloaded by at most one hundred participants (the group cap), so cache reuse is too low for edge caching to pay off
A CDN conflicts with TTL expiration
Pre-signed URLs cannot be paired with a CDN
why: CDN 的价值在「同一内容被海量用户重复拉取」；附件受众被 100 人上限封顶，命中复用少，加 CDN 属于低性价比。
why_en: Since at most one hundred participants will ever fetch an attachment, cache reuse is tiny and a CDN adds little value.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存到靠近用户的边缘节点、就近返回的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content on edge servers near users so it can be served locally.

q: 采用预签名 URL 方案后，仍然没解决的问题有哪些？（多选）
options: 「所有接收者都下载完成后让附件提前过期」没有实现，只能等 30 天 TTL
加密与安全管理仍需要额外步骤
附件大小被限制在 1MB 以内
上传仍必须经过 Chat Server
options_en: Expiring an attachment early once every recipient has downloaded it is still unimplemented; it only ever expires via the thirty-day TTL
Encryption and security management still need extra work
Attachment size is capped at 1MB
Uploads still have to pass through the Chat Server
why: Great 方案也有坦承的边界：按「全部收完即删」提前过期未做，端到端加密与安全要额外设计。面试里主动说出残留问题是加分项。
why_en: Even the ideal approach leaves early expiration after all recipients download unhandled and still requires extra work for encryption and security.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给存储条目设置的存活期限，到期后由存储层自动删除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A TTL is an expiration time after which the storage layer automatically deletes the item.

scenario: 应用注册用户规模达到 10 亿。
q: 按经验比例估算同时在线的并发连接数，最支持下面哪个结论？
options: 同时在线数被严重低估到约 2000 万，后续服务器规模会被估小
同时在线数几乎等于注册用户数（约 10 亿），意味着系统要假设几乎所有人随时在线
同时在线数约 2 亿——这是后续服务器台数、心跳量、轮询量所有估算共用的基数
同时在线数量级不重要，只要单机连接容量够大就能忽略集群规模
options_en: Concurrent users are badly underestimated at about twenty million, which would make every later server-count estimate too small
Concurrent users are nearly equal to registered users (about one billion), implying the system must assume almost everyone is online at once
Concurrent users land around two hundred million — the base figure every later estimate of server count, heartbeat volume, and polling load builds on
The concurrency figure does not matter as long as a single host's connection capacity is large enough
why: 经验比例：10 亿注册用户约 2 亿同时在线；这个数字是后面服务器台数、心跳量、轮询量所有估算的共同基数。
why_en: With a billion registered users you can expect around two hundred million to be connected at any one time, and that number anchors every later estimate.

scenario: WhatsApp 以单机（Erlang）可以撑住 100-200 万条 WebSocket 连接闻名，而同时在线连接数约 2 亿。
q: 把单机连接容量和总并发数放在一起看，最支持下面哪个结论？
options: 单机容量被低估到 1-2 万，必须部署上万台服务器才够
即使单机能扛 100-200 万连接，2 亿总并发仍然需要上百台 Chat Server——单机放不下是所有路由方案要解决的起点
单机连接容量足够大，2 亿并发只需要个位数台服务器
连接容量与服务器台数无关，只由带宽决定
options_en: Per-host capacity is underestimated at ten to twenty thousand, requiring tens of thousands of servers

Even at one to two million connections per host, two hundred million concurrent users still needs hundreds of Chat Servers — a single host is never enough, which is the starting point of every routing deep dive
Per-host capacity is large enough that a single-digit number of servers covers two hundred million users
Connection capacity has nothing to do with server count and is purely a function of bandwidth
why: WhatsApp 以单机 100-200 万连接闻名，但 2 亿并发还是要数百台服务器——「单机放不下」正是所有路由深挖的起点。
why_en: WhatsApp famously served one to two million connections per host, yet two hundred million concurrent users still demand hundreds of chat servers.

q: 「只往 L4 LB 后面加更多 Chat Server」这个天真方案为什么直接失败？
options: LB 撑不住 WebSocket 握手
收到 sendMessage 的服务器不一定持有各接收者的 WebSocket 连接，事件与消息将无法投递
服务器数量太多成本失控
DynamoDB 不支持多个写入者
options_en: The load balancer can't handle WebSocket handshakes
The server that accepts a sendMessage has no guarantee of holding the recipients' WebSocket connections, so events and messages cannot be delivered
Too many servers make the cost spiral out of control
DynamoDB does not support multiple writers
optionMeanings: 把失败归到负载均衡器握手能力上。
把失败归到连接与服务器绑定、跨机器不可见上。
把失败归到服务器成本上。
把失败归到数据库写入限制上。
why: 连接只活在某台服务器的内存里；水平扩容后发送方和接收方大概率不在同一台，裸加机器根本无法投递。面试里千万别停在这一步。
why_en: A server that accepts a message has no guarantee of holding the recipients' connections, so naive horizontal scaling simply cannot deliver events.

scenario: 裸加 Chat Server 无法投递之后，一个常见的直觉方案是借助消息队列：为系统里的每个用户单独建一条队列 topic 当它的收件箱。
q: 「每个用户一个 Kafka topic 当 Inbox」为什么行不通？
options: Kafka 不支持多消费者订阅
Kafka 无法持久化消息
topic 无法动态创建
Kafka 不是为数十亿 topic 设计的：每个 topic 约 50KB 开销，10 亿用户光元数据就要 50TB+
options_en: Kafka does not support multiple consumers on one topic
Kafka cannot persist messages
Topics cannot be created dynamically
Kafka is not built for billions of topics: each carries about 50KB of overhead, so a billion users alone would need over 50TB just for metadata
optionMeanings: 把问题归因到消费者订阅模型。
把问题归因到持久化能力。
把问题归因到 topic 创建方式。
把问题归因到每个 topic 的固定元数据开销。
why: 很多候选人条件反射地掏队列，但 Kafka 每个 topic 都有量级 50KB 的开销，数十亿 topic 完全不现实；「super topic」聚合方案又等于蹩脚地重造 Pub/Sub。
why_en: Kafka is not built for billions of topics since each carries about fifty kilobytes of overhead, which alone would mean over fifty terabytes for a billion users.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把消息持久化到磁盘、按 topic 组织、并维护消费者位点的分布式消息队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue that persists messages to disk, organizes them into topics, and tracks consumer offsets.

scenario: 想让「谁负责哪个用户」变成确定映射：按 userId 一致性哈希把用户固定分配到 Chat Server，服务器之间直连投递。
q: 这个方案还需要什么配套基础设施？
options: 中心注册表（如 ZooKeeper / etcd）：记录 Chat Server 的数量、地址以及各自拥有的一致性哈希段
一个全局关系型数据库存路由
客户端向全网广播自己的位置
DNS 泛解析到任意服务器
options_en: A central registry (such as ZooKeeper or etcd) recording how many Chat Servers exist, their addresses, and which hash-ring segments each owns
A single global relational database storing routing info
Clients broadcast their own location to the whole network
Wildcard DNS resolving to any server
why: 一致性哈希方案的核心配套是服务注册与哈希段分配（ZooKeeper/etcd）；连接请求按 userId 定位归属服务器，事件也直接发往「拥有」该用户的那台。
why_en: Consistent hashing needs a central registry like ZooKeeper or etcd that tracks each chat server's address and the hash ranges it owns.
whenOtherWins: 不想自己管理伸缩编排、能接受多一跳毫秒级延迟时，Redis Pub/Sub 更省心，也是文中评级更高的选择。
tradeoff: 服务器直连低时延 vs 自管路由编排（注册表、扩容迁移）的运维复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式协调服务，常用来做服务注册和配置的强一致存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZooKeeper is a distributed coordination service commonly used for service registration and strongly consistent configuration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分布式强一致键值存储，常用于服务发现和配置管理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: etcd is a strongly consistent distributed key-value store commonly used for service discovery and configuration.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 key 和节点都映射到同一个哈希环上，节点增减时只影响环上相邻的一小段映射关系。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing places both keys and nodes on the same hash ring so adding or removing a node only reshuffles a small neighboring slice of the mapping.

q: 一致性哈希直连方案要付出哪些代价？（多选）
options: 每台 Chat Server 都要与所有其他 Chat Server 保持连接，迫使服务器「个头大、数量少」
扩容 / 缩容要精细编排连接迁移，避免用户集体重连引发惊群
伸缩过渡期要向新旧两台服务器同时发送事件，防止丢消息
userId 从此不能再作数据库分区键
options_en: Every Chat Server must stay connected to every other Chat Server, forcing servers to be few and large
Scaling in or out requires carefully orchestrated connection draining to avoid a thundering herd
During a scaling transition, events must be sent to both the old and new owning server so nothing is lost
userId can no longer be used as a database partition key
why: 全网状互连 + 伸缩编排 + 过渡期双发，问题都可解，但面试官会期待你逐个讲清怎么解——所以它只评 Good 而非 Great。
why_en: Every server must connect to every other server, scaling requires careful connection draining to avoid a thundering herd, and events must go to both owners during transitions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大量客户端因同一事件在同一时刻集体重连或重试，瞬间打垮后端的现象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A thundering herd happens when a huge number of clients reconnect or retry at the same instant and overwhelm the backend.

termDefinitions.meaning: 决定一行数据被分配到哪个物理分区的键。

scenario: 上百台 Chat Server 之间要互相转发消息，接收者可能连在任何一台上；希望用现成的轻量组件专门做服务器间的消息中转。
q: 文中评为最优（Great）的方案是？
options: RabbitMQ 配死信队列
每用户一个 Kafka topic
Redis Pub/Sub：按 userId 建频道，Chat Server 订阅所连用户的频道，发消息即向接收者频道发布
Chat Server 之间 gRPC 全网状广播
options_en: RabbitMQ with a dead-letter queue
One Kafka topic per user
Redis Pub/Sub: build a channel per userId, have each Chat Server subscribe to the channels of its connected users, and publish to the recipient's channel to send
A full mesh of gRPC calls between all Chat Servers
optionMeanings: 带死信队列的消息队列中间件。
为每用户建一条持久化 topic。
按 userId 建频道的轻量转发服务。
服务器间点对点全网状 RPC 广播。
why: Redis Pub/Sub 用极轻的 socket 映射在服务器之间摆渡消息：订阅该用户频道的服务器收到发布后转发进 WebSocket，专器专用。
why_en: Redis Pub/Sub is purpose-built for bouncing messages between servers, using lightweight per-user channels that subscribing chat servers forward into their sockets.
whenOtherWins: 不愿新增 Redis 依赖、且团队能驾驭连接编排时，一致性哈希直连也可行，还省掉经 Redis 的一跳延迟。
tradeoff: 专用轻量转发（Pub/Sub）vs 自建一致性哈希直连路由的运维成本

q: 在「每个 topic / 频道的开销」维度上，Kafka 与 Redis Pub/Sub 的关键区别是？
options: 两者都要为每个频道写磁盘
Kafka 的 topic 更轻量
Redis Pub/Sub 也要维护消费位点
Kafka 要把消息持久化到磁盘并维护消费者 offset，每 topic 开销大；Pub/Sub 频道近似内存里指向订阅连接的指针，不存任何消息
options_en: Both must write to disk for every channel
Kafka topics are actually the lighter-weight option
Redis Pub/Sub also has to track a consumer offset
Kafka persists messages to disk and tracks consumer offsets, so each topic carries real overhead; Pub/Sub channels are just in-memory pointers to subscriber connections and store nothing
optionMeanings: 认为两者磁盘开销一样。
把两者轻重关系说反。
认为 Pub/Sub 也要维护消费位点。
区分持久化落盘和内存指针转发。
why: 同样是发布订阅，Kafka 为持久化与位点付出高昂的 per-topic 成本；Redis Pub/Sub 不管存储、只转发，所以能撑住海量频道。
why_en: Kafka persists messages and tracks consumer offsets per topic, while Redis Pub/Sub channels are just in-memory pointers to subscriber connections with no storage at all.
tradeoff: Pub/Sub 轻量不持久化 vs Kafka 持久化带来的强投递保证

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue that persists messages to disk, organizes them into topics, and tracks consumer offsets.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub is publish-subscribe messaging where a publisher sends to a channel and every current subscriber receives it; Redis does not persist these messages, so one with no subscriber is simply lost.

q: Redis Pub/Sub 的投递语义是？
options: at-most-once：没有订阅者在听、或 Redis 瞬时故障时，那条消息就丢了
exactly-once，绝不重复也绝不丢
at-least-once，可能重复
全局有序且必达
options_en: At-most-once: if no subscriber is listening, or Redis has a transient failure, that message is simply lost
Exactly-once, never duplicated and never lost
At-least-once, may be duplicated
Globally ordered and guaranteed delivery
why: Pub/Sub 不保证送达：无人订阅或瞬断即丢。单看这点像缺陷，但配合「先持久化后发布」的写路径，它恰好只承担尽力而为的实时通道。
why_en: Redis Pub/Sub is at-most-once, so a message is simply lost if no subscriber is listening or Redis hiccups.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布-订阅消息模式：发布者把消息发到一个频道，所有订阅该频道的连接都会收到；Redis 的实现不持久化消息，无人订阅就丢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub is publish-subscribe messaging where a publisher sends to a channel and every current subscriber receives it; Redis does not persist these messages, so one with no subscriber is simply lost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种投递语义：消息最多送达一次，可能因故障直接丢失，但绝不会重复。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: At-most-once delivery means a message is delivered zero or one time; it can be lost on failure but is never duplicated.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种投递语义：消息至少送达一次，可能重复，但不会凭空丢失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: At-least-once delivery guarantees a message arrives one or more times; it may duplicate but never silently disappears.

q: Pub/Sub 可能丢消息，为什么系统整体仍能保证必达？
options: Redis 会对失败的发布自动重试
客户端每次都重发全部消息
发布到 Pub/Sub 之前已先把消息持久化写入 Message 表和 Inbox；推送只是尽力而为，丢了也能靠重连同步或轮询补回
负载均衡器会缓存未送达的消息
options_en: Redis automatically retries failed publishes
The client resends every message every time
The message is durably written to the Message table and Inbox before it is ever published to Pub/Sub; the push is best-effort, and a drop is recovered on reconnect or polling
The load balancer caches undelivered messages
why: 顺序是命门：持久化在前、发布在后，实时通道再不可靠也只是「晚到」，不会「丢失」。这一行字撑起了整个可靠性论证。
why_en: Because messages are durably written to the message and inbox tables before publishing, a dropped pub/sub message is recovered on reconnect or by polling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布-订阅消息模式：发布者把消息发到一个频道，所有订阅该频道的连接都会收到；Redis 的实现不持久化消息，无人订阅就丢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/Sub is publish-subscribe messaging where a publisher sends to a channel and every current subscriber receives it; Redis does not persist these messages, so one with no subscriber is simply lost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 为每个接收者保存未投递消息的持久化队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inbox is a durable per-recipient queue of messages that have not yet been delivered.

q: 补全发消息的写路径顺序：
text: 写路径：1) 持久化写 {{Message}} 表并创建 {{Inbox}} 条目 → 2) 向发送者返回{{成功}} → 3) 发布到 {{Pub/Sub}} 做尽力而为的实时投递。
why: 先落库、再应答、最后发布——这个顺序保证了 at-most-once 的实时通道不会危及必达承诺。
why_en: The write path durably stores the message and inbox entries, returns success to the sender, and only then publishes to pub/sub for best-effort delivery.

why: NTP 不保证完美时钟但足够好；用「服务器收到时间」作为统一排序键，各端展示顺序一致，即使到达顺序不同。
why_en: Chat servers sync clocks over NTP and stamp each message on arrival, and clients display messages sorted by that server timestamp for a consistent order everywhere.

q: 按服务器接收时间排序的可见副作用是什么？
options: 部分消息会永久丢失
偶尔一条消息会「插入」到一条实际发送更晚的消息上方——用户觉得这可以接受
时钟漂移会让消息重复
客户端必须缓存全部历史
options_en: Some messages are permanently lost
Occasionally a message "pops in" above one that was actually sent later — users find this acceptable
Clock drift causes duplicate messages
Clients must cache the entire message history
why: 接收时间 ≠ 发送时间，偶发的 pop-in 在所难免；但这是拿微小的视觉瑕疵换实时性，用户买账。
why_en: Occasionally a message pops in above one that was actually sent later, and users find that acceptable.

q: 「用户每次发消息 / 收消息 / 回心跳都更新一次 lastSeen 字段」这个 naive 方案的问题？
options: 读取延迟太高
巨大的写放大：2 亿在线用户乘以心跳频率 = 每秒数百万次低价值写入，连 DynamoDB 都吃力且费用惊人；而且数据写完立刻过时——在为不需要的强一致付费
时间戳精度不够
会暴露用户隐私 IP
options_en: Read latency becomes too high

Massive write amplification: two hundred million online users times the heartbeat rate means millions of low-value writes per second — even DynamoDB struggles, and the data is stale the instant it lands
Timestamp precision is insufficient
It leaks user IP addresses
optionMeanings: 把问题归到读取延迟上。
把问题归到心跳驱动的写放大上。
把问题归到时间戳精度上。
把问题归到隐私泄露上。
why: 每个活动都写库，写入量被心跳放大到数百万/秒，换来的却是「查到时已过时」的数据——成本与价值完全倒挂。
why_en: Updating last seen on every action creates millions of low-value writes per second that are stale the moment they land, paying for consistency nobody needs.

scenario: 要做「最后在线时间」，希望存储与写入都最小化。两个洞察：用户断连时服务器一定知道；用户在线时他自己能实时告诉你。
q: 文中的设计是？
options: 只在断连时写一条记录，查询时并行读表、经 Pub/Sub 问对方是否在线，合并显示
每分钟对全体在线用户做快照，负载随在线人数线性增长
客户端之间 P2P 互相询问，对方离线时完全查不到结果
在负载均衡器上采集日志离线分析，只能查历史查不了当下
options_en: Write a record only on disconnect, then on query read that table and ask over Pub/Sub in parallel and merge the results
Snapshot every online user once a minute, with load scaling linearly with who is online
Have clients ask each other directly, peer to peer, which finds nothing once the target is offline
Collect load-balancer logs for offline analysis, which only shows history, not the current state
why: 把「在线」交给实时询问、把「离线时间」交给断连时的一次写入：存储最小（每人一条）、写入最少（仅断连时）。
why_en: Durably record only the last disconnect, and on a query check that table while asking the live user over pub/sub in parallel, merging the two responses.
whenOtherWins: 用户量小或需要完整在线历史审计时，按活动直接写库更简单、信息也更全。
tradeoff: 存储与写入最小化 vs 在线状态的实时精确性

q: 两台服务器可能先后为同一用户写断连时间戳，如何防止旧值覆盖更新的值？
options: 写之前抢一把全局锁
随机退避后再写
只允许固定一台服务器负责写
用 DynamoDB 条件写（conditional expression）：仅当新时间戳大于现有值时才更新
options_en: Grab a global lock before writing
Write after a random backoff delay
Let only one fixed server be responsible for writing
Use a DynamoDB conditional write: only update when the new timestamp is greater than the existing value
optionMeanings: 写前抢全局锁。
随机退避后重试写入。
固定单一写者角色。
只有新值更大才允许提交的条件写。
why: 条件写把「比较再更新」压进存储层原子完成：晚到的旧时间戳会条件失败，不会倒退覆盖更近的断连时间。
why_en: A DynamoDB conditional write that only updates when the new timestamp is greater prevents two servers from racing and clobbering a more recent disconnect time.
codeSample:
UpdateItem LastSeen
  Key: { userId: "u_42" }
  SET lastDisconnect = :new
  ConditionExpression: :new > lastDisconnect
# fails harmlessly if another server already wrote a newer timestamp

q: 客户端查询他人 last seen 的完整流程是？
options: 直接读 LastSeen 表并原样返回，不会去问对方当前是否真的在线
服务器并行读 LastSeen 表，同时经 Pub/Sub 问对方是否在线，合并两路结果显示
向全部 Chat Server 广播查询再投票，开销随集群规模线性增长
轮询目标用户直到回应，请求会一直阻塞等待，没有并行的兜底路径
options_en: Read the LastSeen table directly and return it as-is, without asking whether they are actually online right now
The server reads LastSeen and asks the target over Pub/Sub in parallel, then merges the two results to display
Broadcast the query to every Chat Server and vote, with cost scaling linearly with cluster size
Poll the target user repeatedly until they respond, blocking the whole time with no parallel fallback
why: 一次查询、两路并行响应（数据库的历史值 + 实时的在线确认），由客户端合并——存储与实时各答各的强项。
why_en: The server checks the last-seen table and in parallel forwards the query to the target's channel, and the client merges the database answer with any live online reply.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as 请求者客户端
    participant A as Chat Server A
    participant DB as LastSeen 表
    participant B as Chat Server B（目标所在）
    C->>A: getLastSeen(target)
    par 并行
        A->>DB: 读最后断连时间
        A-->>C: updateLastSeen($DATE)
    and
        A->>B: 经 Pub/Sub 转发 getLastSeen
        B-->>C: updateLastSeen(ONLINE)（若在线）
    end
    C->>C: 合并：ONLINE 则绿点，否则显示断连时间

q: last-disconnect 方案的挑战与补强手段有哪些？（多选）
options: 在线用户的两路响应可能一先一后到达，客户端要么稍等再显示、要么支持无缝更新 UI
依赖 Chat Server 上报断连——服务器崩溃时可能漏记（好在用户会很快重连）
补强：连接建立时也写一次 LastSeen 表，进一步提高鲁棒性
必须每秒刷新全体用户的 last seen
options_en: The two parallel responses for an online user may arrive apart, so the client must wait briefly or update the UI seamlessly
It depends on Chat Servers reporting disconnects — a server crash can lose one (though the user usually reconnects quickly)
Mitigation: also write to the LastSeen table when a connection is established, for extra robustness
Every user's last seen must be refreshed every second
why: 两路响应有时差、断连上报可能因服务器故障丢失；「连接时也写一笔」是低成本的加固。这些残留问题要主动讲出来。
why_en: The two responses can arrive apart so the client must merge gracefully, and since servers report disconnects a crash can lose one, mitigated by also writing on connect.

scenario: 面试官按候选人级别（中级 / 高级 / Staff+）调整对广度与深度的期望比例。
q: 补全各级别期望的广度 : 深度比例：
text: 面试期望的广度 : 深度——中级约 {{80}}:20、高级约 60:{{40}}、Staff+ 约 40:{{60}}；级别越高，越要主动识别问题并引领 deep dive，而不是等面试官来驱动。
why: 中级重广度、把功能跑通即可；高级要讲透伸缩与鲁棒性、比较分区策略的利弊；Staff+ 要 2-3 层深入故障模式、瓶颈甚至区域化架构。
why_en: Expectations shift from eighty-twenty breadth versus depth at mid-level, to sixty-forty at senior, to forty-sixty at staff-plus where you proactively lead the deep dives.
